Name: sapling
Rules text: The middle stage of a seed. After 2 of your turns it is an oak.

Name: gold
Rules text: The top of the metal ladder. Incorruptible: no rival word can send it away. 1 more breath each of your turns.
Ladder: lead → tin → silver → gold; copper → silver → gold

Name: ale
Rules text: What the cask became. Each of your turns you gain 2 life and your weakest thing gains +0/+1.

Name: blade
Rules text: What the ingot became.

Name: ash
Rules text: What fire leaves behind. With an ember it is a phoenix.

Name: shade
Rules text: A shade from the barrow. Flies, and lasts 2 turns.

Name: golem
Rules text: Clay given a name. Guardian, heavy. It keeps every shape the clay was given. Not alive: it cannot be poisoned.

Name: phoenix
Rules text: Renewal through loss. Flies. Destroyed, it returns to your hand. Whatever it hits catches fire.
Region or story link: The Cinder Ports · now made only

Name: ouroboros
Rules text: Endings feed beginnings. Gains +1/+1 whenever a thing of yours dies. Destroyed, it returns to your hand.
Fusion partners and results: seed + mycelium (needs brimstone on your side)

Name: world tree
Rules text: Separate lives, one whole. Harm to any other living thing of yours falls on the World Tree instead. You gain 2 life each of your turns.

Name: philosopher’s stone
Rules text: Magnificent, and not the goal. Each of your turns every other thing of yours gains +1/+1. It cannot strike.

Name: eagle
Rules text: Flies. Stoop +2. Nothing opposite stays hidden.

Name: griffin
Rules text: Flies. Heavy: its blows carry through.

Name: thunderbird
Rules text: Flies. +2 strike while any weather stands. When it hits the rival, they take 2 more.

Name: herald
Rules text: Flies. A speaker. When it arrives you draw two words.

Name: loaf
Rules text: Bread. Each of your turns you gain 3 life.

Name: windpump
Rules text: The fen drainers’ mill. Each of your turns you gain 1 breath and the rival takes 2.

Name: firebird
Rules text: Flies, swift. Whatever it hits catches fire, and the rival is burned for 1.

Name: oracle
Rules text: A speaker. Hidden. Each of your turns you draw a word.

Name: hydra
Rules text: Sea-born, toxic. It regains 2 stand each of your turns.

Name: otterhound
Rules text: Sea-born, swift, guardian. It seeps.

Name: aqueduct
Rules text: Guardian. Whatever strikes it is held. Each of your turns the rival takes 2.

Name: steam
Rules text: Fire and water, by salt. Flies. When it arrives everything opposite is soaked and takes 2.
Fusion partners and results: ice + ember (needs salt on your side)

Name: bog hag
Rules text: Toxic. Each of your turns the rival takes a dose of poison.

Name: cider
Rules text: Orchard and brewhouse. Each of your turns you gain 2 life and every thing of yours gains +0/+1.

Name: colossus
Rules text: Stone stood up and walking. Guardian, heavy.

Name: steel
Rules text: Iron folded in the fire. Heavy. Guardians take its blows in full.

Name: bridge
Rules text: The bridge, finished. Your things cannot be blocked while it stands.

Name: tinderbox
Rules text: When it arrives, every rival thing catches fire.

Name: athanor
Rules text: The alchemists’ furnace. Each of your turns the rival is burned for 2 and your ladder things count a turn closer.

Name: architect
Rules text: A speaker. Each of your turns every structure of yours gains +0/+1.

Name: gunpowder
Rules text: Keep it from fire, or bring it to fire. When it dies, everything opposite takes 4 and the rival is burned for 4.

Name: telescope
Rules text: See far. Your spells and weather cost 1 less, nothing opposite stays hidden, and each of your turns you draw a word.

Name: firedrake
Rules text: Flies. Whatever it hits catches fire.

Name: wild hunt
Rules text: Swift. When it arrives, your other beasts may act again.

Name: homunculus
Rules text: A little person grown in a flask. A speaker who counts twice. Your fusions cost 1 less.

Name: panacea
Rules text: When it arrives you gain 6 life and every state on your side is cleared. Each of your turns you gain 2 life.

Name: colony
Rules text: Tiny. Each of your turns it gains +1/+1 and an ant marches out.

Name: hedge
Rules text: A laid hedge. Guardian, thorny. Whatever strikes it cannot act on its next turn.

Name: pestilence
Rules text: Rat and flea. Each of your turns every living rival thing is poisoned and the rival takes a dose.

Name: wraith
Rules text: Flies. Hidden. Nothing can block it.

Name: lich
Rules text: A scholar who would not die. A speaker. Destroyed, it returns to your hand.

Name: paper
Rules text: Rag and pulp made new. When it arrives you draw two words. Your spells and weather cost 1 less.

Name: book
Rules text: Discarded pages, bound. A speaker. Each of your turns you draw a word.

Name: wight
Rules text: The barrow’s keeper. Whatever it destroys rises on your side as a shade.

Name: sage
Rules text: Knows every name. A speaker who counts twice. The first word you play each turn costs 1 less.

Name: broadside
Rules text: Printed and posted. Whenever you speak a spell, the rival takes 2.

Name: mint
Rules text: The publisher’s money. 1 more breath each of your turns, and your spells and weather cost 1 less.
